name: Amatsukaze ~Kugutsu Jinpuu-chou~
source:
When Mochizuki Hidemitsu, Lord of Azuma and head of one of the great 13 Houses, dies under suspicious circumstances and the lord governing the neighboring Asaka, Ashiya Tatsuyoshi, tries to force Hidemitsu's daughter, Sayo-hime, to marry him, she asks the shinobi of Kasumidanishuu to investigate the death. 
While they manage to uncover the truth about the death, this ultimately leads to the annihilation of Kasumidanishuu on the hands of the Meigokutou, a group of Shinobi allied to Ashiya.
The survivors rally around Yashiro Jinma, who becomes the leader of the group that Sayo-hime dubs the Yamabukigumi.

Asaka has one of the largest army in the Dragon Realm as well the support of the Meigokutou and apparently the tacit approval of the shogunate.
On the other hand the retainers of the Mochizuki house are split on the question whether to fight or to negotiate, is much less militarily focused and the Yamabukigumi is small and disorganized.
But they have even stronger cards...
translation:
统治吾妻、十三名家之一的当主望月秀光离奇身亡。邻国朝香的领主芦屋龙良试图强迫秀光之女佐代姬嫁给自己，她于是委托霞谷众的忍者调查父亲死因。
忍者们虽然成功查明真相，却因此遭到与芦屋结盟的忍者集团冥极党的灭门袭击。
幸存者们聚集在八代阵马身边，由他担任首领；佐代姬将这个团体命名为山吹组。

朝香拥有龙之国规模最大的军队之一，又得到冥极党的支持，幕府似乎也在暗中默许。
另一方面，望月家的家臣对究竟应战还是议和意见分裂，军事力量也弱得多，山吹组更是规模狭小、组织松散。
但他们手中有着更强的王牌……
